name: Gelato x Fat & Weird | 200mg Cookie | Dubai Chocolate
description: Introducing a first of its kind edible collab between Gelato Canna x Fat & Weird Cookie!! Our Dubai Chocolate cookie is enrobed in distillate infused chocolate and it's made with a dark chocolate cookie base, creamy pistachio core, and a crispy kataifi crunch finished with a pistachio topping for a rich, decadent flavor profile.
